name: Founder decision: Confirm the founding compensation commitments as the charter's people section
text_content:
The white paper states compensation commitments case by case and never as a philosophy: labor as an asset rather than a cost to minimize; the company pays for what matters and does not shift costs to employees; dignity as a precondition for presence; compensation built into price, never a tip, never a service charge, never presented as one; distributed to the whole team including the kitchen; no hierarchy of importance; cross-strand fluency recognized in pay; benefits planned from the start.

The decision is to confirm this list as Sŏn's founding compensation commitments, add any the record does not hold, and keep them separate from the architecture (percentage, point weights, payment rhythm), which Session 13 builds against them.

Session 2 recommends the split: commitments in the charter because they are founding commitments and every hiring session from Session 5 needs them to score against; architecture in Session 13.

No figure is carried here. The record states the embedded percentage is still being finalized, and financials are not a context source for this program.

Brandon confirms. Dominic reviews before Session 13. Filed by Session 2. Reasoning is in section 10 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
